scope: Read-only inspection of existing L2 artifacts; no replay or new execution
sourceReasoning: Secondary initializes to 15 and becomes 1 only after successful OPEN/CLOSE of I0. SAVE is the only subsequent error branch. Retained secondary=1, first filename G1T00, zero successful files, full remaining bytes and staged first chunk distinguish the first SAVE failure from initialization failure in these Xemu dumps.
physicalBoundary: Terminal S5/E03/F00 and returned files alone do not expose secondary/chunk/remaining or identify which KERNAL call failed. No physical SAVE-branch or DOS-status-channel provenance is added.
retryBoundary: No automatic retry follows the admitted owner control flow; the terminal halt is observable. The carrier contains no physical retry counter or call log.
